content:
kevin: Kicked off a config-only deploy for tonight's window — throttles, routing weights, and batching params. tagging for ops handoff @maria @sanjay

deploy-bot: Deploy started: config-only rollout v2026.03.21-cfg. Canary=3% on eu-west-1, target groups: small-tenants. Tracking: https://deploy.redwood.internal/rolls/1719302468 :shipit:

maria: ack. I'll watch latency and 99p tail. Please call out the exact keys changed in the patch so I can correlate metrics.

kevin: diff below (only keys changed):
```json
{
  "routing": {
    "weight_override": {
      "low_priority": 0.6,
      "medium_priority": 1.0
    },
    "timeout_ms": 2200
  },
  "batching": {
    "max_batch_tokens": 2048,
    "prefer_latency": true,
    "dynamic_window_ms": 35
  },
  "limits": {
    "tenant_qps_floor": 2,
    "global_concurrency_cap": 420
  }
}
```

sanjay: quick note — prefer_latency=true will reduce batching efficiency, expect ~7-12% cost increase on heavy seqs. confirm this tradeoff for canary?

kevin: yes, tradeoff accepted for this change window; we need lower 95/99. Will scope to small-tenants canary and pin model variant latest-quant.

maria: observed canary ramp to 3% ~5m after start, latency p95 down ~120ms, p99 down ~340ms, but kvcache miss rate up ~6% which is ok. No error spike. :thumbsup:

ops-runner: Scheduling staggered widen at +30m and +60m if no regressions. Rollback plan: manual unpin + deployment of previous config snapshot snap-1719200000 if p99 > baseline+25% or error rate >0.5%.

esther: Can we pin heavy enterprise tenants to old routing weight to avoid impact? I recommend adding override:
```yaml
overrides:
  tenant_ids: ["tenant-acme", "tenant-globex"]
  routing.weight_override.low_priority: 0.2
```
If yes I'll add before the +30m widen.

kevin: good idea. esther, please add override and push a small hot-config; mark it as staged so deploy-bot picks it up.

esther: pushed override (staged). Deploy-bot acknowledged: staged config id cfg-1719302510.

ben: Observability checks to watch: token_svc.latency.p99, request_rate.errors, kvcache.miss_rate, batch.size.avg. I added dashboards to the rollout watchlist.

maria: +1 on dashboards. ops-runner, start automated abort if p99 crosses threshold for 3 consecutive 1m windows.

ops-runner: automated abort rule added. Canary at 3% stable for 18m. Preparing +30m widen to 10% in eu-west-1.

kevin: proceeding with widen schedule. If anything odd ping in #eng-oncall and @maria directly. Thanks everyone.

deploy-bot: Rollout update: canary stable; widening to 10% in 5m. Next update at +35m or on abort.

maria: quick postmortem note for release notes: change window 21-Mar-2026, config-only, lowered timeout to 2200ms, batching pref for latency, tenant overrides for enterprise. I'll draft release blurb after 60m confirmation.

kevin: perfect — let's keep this thread for rollback/notes. If we hit rollback, log the exact revert command and reason here.
